subject: Interim rebate ask for long-sequence support slip — expedited approval request
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice@finedge.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@finedge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Launch impact + interim credit proposal for long-sequence support delay

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks again for the candid call this morning. I wanted to capture next steps so we move quickly. As we discussed, FinEdge’s integration relied on our long-sequence support (>= 8k tokens) to handle multi-document risk scoring. The feature will ship in the next release, but not in time for their planned pilot next week.

Given the launch timing and the integration work already invested on both sides, FinEdge has requested an interim commercial accommodation to keep their pilot on track. They’ve proposed either a temporary route to a higher-capacity model (higher unit cost) or a one-time credit to offset extra infra and engineering hours.

Internal ask: can we approve a short-term rebate (one-time credit up to $45k or a 3-month 20% rate reduction on tokens consumed, whichever is smaller) while Product finalizes long-seq support? We need a conditional exec sign-off to present numbers to procurement by COB Monday.

Attached: impact_report_longseq.pdf (customer impact summary), mvp_timeline_v2.xlsx (product ETA and milestones).

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the official request doc after I have guidance on structure/cap.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Alice Park <alice@finedge.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@finedge.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch impact + interim credit proposal for long-sequence support delay

Hi all —

Thanks for the note, Soojin. Quick technical update to set expectations: the long-seq path requires changes across the KV cache and attention kernel selection. We can deliver a targeted improvement for the use-case (document concatenation + sliding-window attention) in ~3 weeks with an interim model variant; full, optimized long-seq will take ~7–8 weeks for testing and perf tuning.

Two options from engineering standpoint:
- Ship an interim model variant in ~3 weeks and provide a temporary routing policy from hosted to that variant (higher cost per token, slight latency increase).
- Delay pilot and prioritize the full long-seq fix (~7–8 weeks).

If customer needs to keep pilot date, the interim routing + a commercial offset (credit or discounted rate) is reasonable. If we go the routing approach, we will also need a temporary SLA carveout for latency targets.

Happy to sync with product ops and security for any additional constraints. Attaching the updated timeline in the spreadsheet.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Sr. Product Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Park <alice@finedge.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch impact + interim credit proposal for long-sequence support delay

Team —

I support offering a commercial accommodation to protect the relationship and preserve momentum. A few guardrails for approval:
1) Cap the one-time credit to a fixed dollar amount or a capped percent of ARR — we should not open an unbounded precedent.
2) Prefer a one-time credit structure tied to a committed pilot/poC that converts to paid usage within 90 days.
3) Legal and Finance must sign off on the wording and accounting treatment.

Proposed structure (quick): one-time credit up to $35,000 + optional 30-day reduced token rate (15%) for pilot traffic, conditioned on a signed statement of the pilot scope and go-live date. If FinEdge prefers longer term discount, we should convert to a formal price promotion with a defined term and renewal triggers.

Soojin — please draft the commercial exception doc and include the absolute cap, acceptance criteria, and rollback conditions. Laura — can you confirm accounting treatment and whether we need CFO sign-off for $35k?

— Vivek
VP, Commercials
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T15:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch impact + interim credit proposal for long-sequence support delay

All —

I can approve up to $10k as an operations-level concession. Anything above that requires commercial exception approval from the Revenue Committee (Marissa). For $35k we will need an explicit Exec sign-off and a short memo for audit. Please provide:
- Expected revenue at risk (monthly run rate) / show the math for the $35k ask
- Proposed accounting entry (credit memo or contra-revenue)
- Statement of pilot commitment (signed by customer)

Soojin — can you attach the signed pilot scope or procurement note? Also link the HubSpot deal record so I can reconcile. Once we have the items above I’ll route to Finance Ops and schedule for the committee review.

— Laura
Laura Bennett | Head, Commercial Finance
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch impact + interim credit proposal for long-sequence support delay

Thanks for driving this. I’ve reviewed the impact packet and the ask. Conditional approval granted as follows:

- One-time commercial credit: up to $30,000 (to be issued as a credit memo).
- Optional short-term rate reduction: 20% for pilot traffic for up to 30 days only, explicitly timeboxed.
- Preconditions: signed pilot scope from FinEdge, HubSpot deal updated with concession line item, and Finance Ops to confirm journal entry.

Communication: Soojin, please share the formal customer email (copy to Legal) with the concession terms and publish the exception into the CommercialExceptionLog (link above). Karthik — ensure we document the routing/SLA carveout. Laura — proceed with accounting and inform me once the credit memo is ready.

We should track this as a precedent; Compliance/RevOps to review for any policy changes.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | VP Revenue Operations
